Synthetic Multi-Facet EMA Diary LLM Coding Dataset

Source: R/data.R
ema_coded.Rd

A compact, reproducible synthetic dataset simulating an Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) emotional-distress coding study. Contains 120 diary entries nested within 30 participants (cluster), scored across a fully crossed 3 prompts x 2 models LLM coding design (720 rows total). A random validation subset of 50 entries carries human gold-standard ratings (human_score), while the remaining 70 entries are unlabeled (NA), making ema_coded ready for demonstrating g_study(), d_study(), calibration_metrics(), dpf_test(), ppi_lm(), and ppi_lmer().

Usage

ema_coded

Format

A tibble::tibble() with 720 rows and 10 variables:

unit_id

Character unique diary entry identifier ("u_0001".."u_0120").

cluster

Character participant identifier ("cl_001".."cl_030").

prompt

Character prompt template ID ("direct", "rubric", "cot").

model

Character LLM model ID ("model_a", "model_b").

temperature

Numeric sampling temperature (0).

replicate

Integer replicate index (1L).

llm_score

Numeric LLM-generated emotional distress rating.

human_score

Numeric human gold-standard distress rating (observed on 50 validation entries; NA on 70 unlabeled entries).

group

Factor demographic/experimental subgroup ("group_a", "group_b"), with mild uniform DPF injected for group_b.

x

Numeric standardized daily stressor predictor.

Source

Deterministically generated via simulate_coding_study().

Examples

data(ema_coded)
g_study(ema_coded, score_col = "llm_score", facets = c("prompt", "model"))
#> 
#> ── Generalizability Study (G-Study)
